name: skill-rigor
description: Quality gate for Claude Code skill authoring: whenever a skill is being created or edited, the work runs at maximum reasoning effort — via the bundled max-effort skill-rigor agent (inheriting the session's model) when the session runs lower — and the result is cross-checked against the skill-creator and skill-development skills when installed, degrading gracefully when they're absent. Auto-engages via the 'skill-rigor' skill on any SKILL.md or skills/ work; slash-available as /skill-rigor:skill-rigor.
